rationale: Price is only $0.05 above entry and has not approached the $40.75 invalidation level, so the thesis remains technically alive; however, the single post-entry candle closed at its high (40.36) on minimal volume (870 shares), and the 9-EMA has essentially caught up to price, removing the prior bearish divergence as a near-term edge. With 89 minutes remaining and VWAP still ~$1.33 below current price as the target, holding is preferable to absorbing double-spread costs from a premature exit while the position sits well within its risk envelope.
